blockingFindings.summary: REQ-204's Acceptance Criteria explicitly scope removal to only the ★COLONY BOOTSTRAP PRIORITY★ block plus two named phrases ('REQ-204 targets only the imperative/ranking language named above'), but the CURRENT file contains a third, equally-real ranking phrase in the same paragraph as one of the named phrases ('the highest-leverage move is to POST', line 71) that REQ-204 never names and therefore never requires Phase 3 to remove.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: REQ-204 exists specifically to make REQ-203's 'no steering/ranking text' principle true of the codebase; a Phase 3 implementation that satisfies REQ-204's own stated acceptance criteria to the letter would still leave a real, evidenced violation of REQ-203 in the shipped file, and PROP-204a's narrow grep-target method could report PASS on the same file state that PROP-203b's broader claim would have to report FAIL against -- a non-binary, self-contradictory verification outcome for the identical code.
